Eli (CEO): Quick check-in — high level for this week: 1) Stabilize API p95 latency to <400ms; 2) Finish Private GA checklist and comms; 3) Smooth Dedicated capacity rollout. Also a quick note on last week's embeddings blip — team did a fast mitigation, thanks SRE. Below are asks and owners.

Priya (VP Product): Noted. I'll draft the customer-facing note for Dedicated + Private GA FAQ. Will sync with growth on messaging.

Marco (CTO): Eng infra will throttle the canary to 50 rps/pod and run the new kernel optimizations. Posting memory profile to the channel after load test.

Ana (Head Eng): Autoscaler PR #482 is targeting predictive mode; trying to land by EOD. Running canary in staging tonight. Small log we saw during repro:```
ERROR 03:14 model_kv_cache OOM
stack: kv_cache::alloc -> fallback path
```

Sana (Head SRE): Incident summary (embeddings, Thu): CPU spike tied to KV cache growth + model variant mismatch. Immediate mitigation: prefix caching enabled, circuit breaker lowered. Root cause analysis in progress — aiming for postmortem by Fri COB. Pager rotation tweak pushed.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: dedicated-v2 -> staging at 05:30 UTC :rocket: (user: Ana)

Priya (VP Product): Can we hold the main prod deploy until autoscaler PR is validated against the canary results?

Ana (Head Eng): SGTM. I'll run 100% load test tonight (10k qps for 30m) and share results.

Marco (CTO): I'll validate fallback model variants and quantization profiles — will confirm compatibility matrix by Tue EOD.

Eli (CEO): Action items (owners / due):
- Ana: complete autoscaler validation and post canary report (due Wed 18:00 UTC).
- Marco: confirm fallback models/quant profiles and share matrix (due Tue EOD).
- Priya: finalize customer comms + status page copy for Dedicated/Private GA (due Wed noon).
- Sana: postmortem draft for embeddings incident + proposed runbook changes (due Fri COB).

Eli (CEO): Risk note — if canary shows KV cache regression, prioritize rollback and engage Dedicated capacity fallback. Keep me posted hourly during deploy windows.

Ana (Head Eng): Ack. I'll put test artifacts in the staging-run artifacts folder and ping here when done.

Sana (Head SRE): Ack — postmortem cadence scheduled, will attach timeline and mitigations.

Marco (CTO): Ack.

Priya (VP Product): Ack, will circulate comms draft for review in 2 hours.

Eli (CEO): Thanks all — quick ❤️ or :thumbsup: so I know everyone saw this.
